column1: # How each occurrence source names the species BirdView draws.
# Generated by cmd/birdview-names. Not a copy of anything published.
# Records each database holds in the US and Canada under the AviList
# binomial BirdView serves. A species far outside the usual eBird:iNat
# ratio is one the two databases disagree about -- a rename, a lump, a
# shared name, or a species eBird withholds (T-028, CR-034, CR-035).
# Sources: EOD - eBird Observation Dataset, doi:10.15468/aomfnb, and the
# iNaturalist research-grade dataset. Both CC BY 4.0.
